lead: Ask for what you are missing. Offer what you can spare. People who want the same thing team up in groups with goals.

need.text: What you are missing. From cake and tea to a bike lane.

offerTitle: Offer what you can. Find what you need.

bots.title: A space without bots

secret.text: Only totals are counted. Nobody can see who voted for what.

life.title: For every part of life
life.text: Find a flatmate, start a band, raise seed money or save the playground. All in one place.
